name: const unsafe fn transmute < Src , Dst > (src : Src) -> Dst
rule: Calling `assume_init()` on the result of transmuting `*const ()` to `MaybeUninit<usize>` completes the pointer-to-integer transmutation; in a `const` context, this is undefined behavior unless the original pointer was created from an integer.
api: const unsafe fn transmute < Src , Dst > (src : Src) -> Dst
